title: Gamescom 2026 参观人数增长 6%，达 36.8 万人
content:
Gamescom 2026 attendance rose 6% to 368,000 visitors | GamesIndustry.biz

.
Gamescom 2026 attracted 368,000 visitors from 131 countries, a 6% increase over the previous year.
A total of 1,743 companies from 66 countries exhibited, up 11% from 2025. International exhibitors accounted for 72% of participants, with 48 country pavilions representing 41 countries.
Brazil, Canada, and the US saw the strongest growth. Over 36,000 trade visitors attended, with about half coming from outside Germany.
Gamescom Dev attendance rose 15% to 6,200 visitors. The conference, which took place prior to Gamescom, featured 397 speakers, 238 sessions, and 18 stages.
More than 2,500 companies from 95 countries participated, along with 57 partners and exhibitors across Gamescom Dev and its indie expo.
GamesIndustry.biz
spoke with Gamescom Dev managing director Frederik Hammes
about the results of this year's
Gamescom Dev survey
, which identified smaller studios as the largest growth opportunity in the games market.
Gamescom's digital content reached over 624 million global views by Saturday evening, including
78 million for Opening Night Live
. The Gamescom Awesome Indies Show attracted more than 302,000 viewers, a growth of over 670%.
Digital community adventure Gamescom Epix generated 6.2 million page views, up approximately 9% from the previous year.
"In 2026, Gamescom has delivered an impressive statement about its role as the central platform for the international games industry," said German Games Industry Association managing director Felix Falk.
"Many of last year's record figures were surpassed, especially in terms of international participation and the number of exhibitors. The drive for the future can be felt here – it's what again propels the industry forward this year despite the challenges – and what makes the gamescom atmosphere so unique."
President and chief executive officer of Koelnmesse Gerald Böse added: "Gamescom brings people from all over the world together, combining the economic and social significance of games on a scale like no other. This was an extremely successful Gamescom, and we are delighted by the event's strong international character. It shows gamescom's ever-growing importance as the leading platform for everyone who plays, develops and creates games."
Gamescom 2027 will take place from August 25 to 29, with Gamescom Dev running from August 23 to 24.
